our_interpretation: The specified behavior is antisemitism, praise for Hitler and sexual-violence output, as identified immediately before the claim.
The plain reading is comparative susceptibility under ordinary or lightly adversarial prompting, not perfect immunity to harmful output.
'Most' means a majority of a defensible set of contemporary major model families. ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini are examples, not a speaker-specified exhaustive set.
Read 'not inevitable' as a practical claim that deployed LLMs can avoid this pattern, not a claim that no LLM can ever be induced to produce harmful content.
Assess the contemporary state during July 2025 up to publication, rather than later model versions.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable tests of contemporary models show that a majority of major alternatives avoid these outputs under prompts that elicit them from Grok, or require materially more elaborate attacks.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable tests show that at least half of the relevant major alternatives produce the specified outputs with similar or less adversarial effort.
